topic: Transferring a Car Title Bought from a Private Seller

script.title: AT THE TITLE COUNTER
script.story_hook: The title is signed, but the sale isn't done.
script.intro_zh: 車權狀簽好了，但這筆交易還沒完成。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the DMV title counter. Listen for lines that save you a second trip.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到車管處的過戶窗口。留意那些讓你少跑一趟的說法。
script.outro: That's a title transfer done right. Listen again and say it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一筆過戶手續就這樣辦好。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat every line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a young man in his late twenties with short straight black hair, thin silver glasses, a slate grey hoodie, a navy backpack on one shoulder, and a slim build
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged woman in her fifties with shoulder-length dark blonde hair pinned in a low clip, small oval glasses, a navy DMV polo shirt with an ID badge, and a sturdy build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, ticket forty-one? Is the counter open?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈtɪkɪt ˈfɔɹɾi ˈwʌn ɪz ðə ˈkaʊnɾɚ ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，四十一號還在叫嗎？櫃台有開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, have a seat and I'll call you up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈhæv ə ˈsit ænd aɪl ˈkɔl ju ˈup/
dialogue.zh: 有的，請先坐下，我會叫你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks. I bought a car from a private seller.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks aɪ ˈbɑt ə ˈkɑɹ ˈfɹəm ə ˈpraɪvɪt ˈsɛlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。我向私人賣家買了輛車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, so we'll transfer the title today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt soʊ wil ˈtɹænsfɚ ðə ˈtaɪɾəl təˈde/
dialogue.zh: 好，那我們今天就來辦過戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the plan. Here's the signed title.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈplæn hɪɹz ðə ˈsaɪnd ˈtaɪɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 就是這麼打算。這是簽好名的車權狀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, the seller's signature looks a little light.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðə ˈsɛlɚz ˈsɪɡnətʃɚ ˈlʊks ə ˈlɪɾəl ˈlaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，賣家的簽名看起來有點淡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, is that a problem? He did sign it.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɪz ˈðæt ə ˈpɹɑbləm ˈhi dɪd ˈsaɪn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 噢，會有問題嗎？他真的有簽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can work with it, no worries for now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kən ˈwɝk ˈwɪð ɪt noʊ ˈwɝɪz fɚ ˈnaʊ/
dialogue.zh: 勉強看得過去，暫時不用擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. What else do you need from me?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wʌt ˈɛls du ju ˈnid fɹəm mi/
dialogue.zh: 好，你還需要我準備什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you have a bill of sale anywhere?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ə ˈbɪl əv ˈseɪl ˈɛniwɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 你有帶買賣契約單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, I have a text message instead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm aɪ hæv ə ˈtɛkst ˈmɛsɪdʒ ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我只有手機訊息可以代替。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Printed out? That works here, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈprɪntɪd ˈaʊt ðæt wɝks hɪɹ ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 列印出來了嗎？在我們這裡一樣能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cousin printed it at the library for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈkʌzən ˈprɪntɪd ɪt æt ðə ˈlaɪbɛɹi fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 我表哥幫我在圖書館印好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. What was the purchase price?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt wʌt wəz ðə ˈpɝtʃəs ˈpraɪs/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。購買金額是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four thousand, cash, and I kept no receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ ˈθaʊzənd ˈkæʃ ænd aɪ ˈkɛpt noʊ rɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 四千塊現金，我沒留收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the sales tax is due at this counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə ˈseɪlz ˈtæks ɪz du æt ðɪs ˈkaʊnɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那銷售稅要在這個櫃台繳清。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much am I looking at here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmʌtʃ æm aɪ ˈlʊkɪŋ æt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我大概要繳多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About three hundred thirty, based on our rate.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt θri ˈhʌndɹəd ˈθɝɹi ˈbeɪst ɑn ˈaʊɚ ˈreɪt/
dialogue.zh: 照我們的稅率算，大約三百三十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ouch, well, better to pay it right.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊtʃ wɛl ˈbɛɾɚ tə ˈpeɪ ɪt ˈɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嘖，好吧，該繳的就乖乖繳清。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart answer. Now, did you get a smog check?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ˈænsɚ naʊ dɪd ju ɡɛt ə ˈsmɑɡ ˈtʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。那你有排氣檢驗報告嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The seller said his was still valid.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɛlɚ sɛd hɪz wəz ˈstɪl ˈvælɪd/
dialogue.zh: 賣家說他的報告還在效期內。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me type in the plate and look.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi ˈtaɪp ɪn ðə ˈpleɪt ænd lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 讓我輸入車牌號碼查一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, the number is on this paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ðə ˈnʌmbɚ ɪz ɑn ðɪs ˈpeɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好，號碼就在這張紙上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay... good news, it passes through November.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ɡʊd nuz ɪt ˈpæsɪz θɹu noʊˈvɛmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好…好消息，它的效期可以到十一月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank goodness, that saved me a stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ˈɡʊdnəs ðæt ˈseɪvd mi ə ˈstɑp/
dialogue.zh: 謝天謝地，那我就少跑一趟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next question, is there a loan on the car?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst ˈkwɛstʃən ɪz ðɛɹ ə ˈloʊn ɑn ðə ˈkɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 下一個問題，這台車還有貸款嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A loan? He paid it off last spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈloʊn hi ˈpeɪd ɪt ˈɔf ˈlæst ˈspɹɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 貸款？他去年春天就還清了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A lien release should go with the title.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlin rɪˈlis ʃʊd ɡoʊ wɪð ðə ˈtaɪɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 那要有一份清貸證明跟著權狀一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, he did mention a bank letter.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ hi dɪd ˈmɛnʃən ə ˈbæŋk ˈlɛɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，他之前是有提過銀行的信。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Without it, I can't close the transfer today.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪˈðaʊt ɪt aɪ kænt kloʊz ðə ˈtɹænsfɚ təˈde/
dialogue.zh: 沒有那個，我今天沒辦法完成過戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So what happens now? I need this car.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌt ˈhæpənz naʊ aɪ nid ðɪs ˈkɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那現在怎麼辦？我很需要這台車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can hold your file for ten days.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kən ˈhoʊld jɔɹ ˈfaɪl fɚ tɛn ˈdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把你的檔案保留十天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten days, so I'd come back here again?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈdeɪz soʊ aɪd kʌm bæk hɪɹ əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 十天，那我還要再跑一趟這裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or text me a photo of the release letter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔɹ tɛkst mi ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ðə rɪˈlis ˈlɛɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 或者你把那張證明拍照傳給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll call him right now, wait a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ˈkɔl hɪm ˈɹaɪt ˈnaʊ ˈweɪt ə ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 我現在就打給他，稍等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All right, the photo came through, I have it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ˈɹaɪt ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ kɛm θɹu aɪ hæv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，照片傳進來了，我這邊收到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, one more question about my insurance.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wʌn mɔɹ ˈkwɛstʃən əˈbaʊt maɪ ˈɪnʃɚəns/
dialogue.zh: 好，再問一個保險的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, show me your current insurance card.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʃoʊ mi jɔɹ ˈkɝənt ˈɪnʃɚəns ˈkɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 好，請讓我看你現在的保險卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's digital, is a screenshot enough?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈdʌdʒɪtəl ɪz ə ˈskɹinʃɑt ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 我的是電子卡，截圖可以用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A screenshot works, the dates must be current.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈskɹinʃɑt wɝks ðə ˈdeɪts məst bi ˈkɝənt/
dialogue.zh: 截圖能用，不過日期要在效期內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, coverage started the first of this month.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ˈkʌvɹɪdʒ ˈstɑɹɾɪd ðə ˈfɝst əv ðɪs ˈmʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 給你看，保單這個月初剛生效。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All set, so I'll take the tax payment.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl sɛt soʊ aɪl ˈteɪk ðə ˈtæks ˈpeɪmənt/
dialogue.zh: 都齊了，那我現在收稅金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card okay, or do you only take cash?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹd oʊˈkeɪ ɔɹ du ju ˈoʊnli ˈteɪk ˈkæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡可以嗎，還是只收現金？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cards are fine, insert and follow the prompts.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹdz ɑɹ ˈfaɪn ɪnˈsɝt ænd ˈfɑloʊ ðə ˈpɹɑmpsts/
dialogue.zh: 卡片沒問題，插卡後照著螢幕提示做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Uh, it says decline. I'll try my other card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌ ɪt sɛz dɪˈklaɪn aɪl tɹaɪ maɪ ˈʌðɚ ˈkɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 呃，它顯示拒絕。我換那張卡試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes that one fails, try the tap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz ðæt ˈwʌn ˈfeɪlz ˈtɹaɪ ðə ˈtæp/
dialogue.zh: 那台偶爾會讀不到，改用輕碰試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There we go, it went through on one tap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ wi ɡoʊ ɪt wɛnt θɹu ɑn ˈwʌn ˈtæp/
dialogue.zh: 好了，碰一下就付款成功。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now pick your plate design at machine three.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ˈpɪk jɔɹ ˈpleɪt dɪˈzaɪn æt məˈʃin θɹi/
dialogue.zh: 現在到三號自助機挑選車牌樣式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mountain one? That's my favorite.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmaʊnɾən wʌn ðæts maɪ ˈfeɪvɚɪt/
dialogue.zh: 山景那款嗎？我最喜歡它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most folks choose it, there's a twenty dollar fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈfoʊks ˈtʃuz ɪt ðɛɹz ə ˈtwɛnɾi ˈdɑlɚ ˈfi/
dialogue.zh: 多數人都選它，要再加二十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Worth every dollar, honestly. I'll take it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɝθ ˈɛvɹi ˈdɑlɚ ˈɑnəstli aɪl ˈteɪk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 每一塊錢都值得，老實說我要了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. Your new registration comes by mail.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn jɔɹ ˈnu ˌɹɛdʒəˈstɹeʃən kʌz ˈbaɪ ˈmeɪl/
dialogue.zh: 辦好了。你的新行照會用郵寄的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the plates? Can I drive today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈpleɪts kæn aɪ ˈdɹaɪ təˈde/
dialogue.zh: 那車牌呢？我今天能開車上路嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's a temporary tag, tape it inside the rear window.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz ə ˈtɛmpəɹɛɹi ˈtæɡ ˈteɪp ɪt ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈɹɪr ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 這是臨時牌照，拿膠帶貼在後車窗裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? On the left or the right corner?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlaɪk ðɪs ɑn ðə ˈlɛft ɔɹ ðə ˈɹaɪt ˈkɔɹnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 像這樣嗎？貼左下角還是右下角？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left corner, so the cars behind can see it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛft ˈkɔɹnɚ soʊ ðə ˈkɑɹz bɪˈhaɪnd kæn ˈsi ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 左下角，這樣後面的車才看得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You made a scary trip feel easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈmeɪd ə ˈskɛɹi ˈtɹɪp ˈfil ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 我本來超緊張，你讓這趟變得好輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, that's what the counter is actually for.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðæts wʌt ðə ˈkaʊnɾɚ ɪz ˈæktʃuəli fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這就是這個櫃台存在的意義。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One plate, two new stickers, one happy driver.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌn ˈpleɪt tu ˈnu ˈstɪkɚz ˈwʌn ˈhæpi ˈdɹaɪvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 一塊新車牌、兩張新貼紙，還有一個開心的駕駛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drive safe, and welcome to the DMV family.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɹaɪv ˈseɪf ænd ˈwɛlkəm tə ðə ˌdiˌɛmˈvi ˈfæməli/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢開，歡迎成為這裡的一分子。

script.youtube_title: 【買二手車過戶🚗】「每一塊錢都值得」🥸💳｜聽完就敢自己跑車管處辦事｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Used Car Title Transfer
script.youtube_title_en: "Worth Every Dollar" — Transferring a Used Car Title at the DMV
script.youtube_description:
「每一塊錢都值得」——在車管處幫一台跟私人買的二手車辦過戶，到底要帶哪些文件？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在車管處最忙碌的過戶窗口。

你會聽到：開場說明來意、交出簽好名的車權狀；簽名太淡時櫃台人員怎麼回應；沒有買賣契約單時如何用手機訊息印件代替；銷售稅金額怎麼問、刷卡失敗怎麼救場；賣家貸款結清了但清貸證明沒在手上時檔案怎麼保留十天；還有臨時牌照要貼在哪個角落的實用問句。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，語氣就是美國人在櫃台每天說話的樣子：um、well、oh、ouch、there we go。聽完你就會用：Here's the signed title、Do you have a bill of sale、How much am I looking at here、It went through。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先熟起來，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺，下次辦事前複習一遍。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Worth every dollar" — how do you transfer the title of a car bought from a private seller without a second trip? This 60-line immersive English listening practice takes place right at the DMV title counter.

You will hear: opening the transaction with a signed title, handling a too-light signature, using a printed text message as a bill of sale, asking about sales tax, saving a declined card payment, a missing lien release with a ten-day file hold, and where the temporary tag goes on the rear window.

Everything stays in A2-level words with real counter speech: um, well, oh, ouch, there we go. By the end you'll own lines like Here's the signed title, Do you have a bill of sale, and It went through on one tap.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
跟私人賣家買了一台二手車，走進車管處卻緊張到手心出汗：要帶哪些文件？少帶一樣會不會白跑？賣家的貸款結清了、清貸證明卻不在手上怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家坐在車管處的過戶窗口，從叫號開場、交件、談銷售稅、刷卡，一路聽到檔案保留、臨時牌照與道別，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
📄 交件句：That's the plan. Here's the signed title.
🧾 補文件：Do you have a bill of sale anywhere?
💳 刷卡救場：Uh, it says decline. I'll try my other card.
🚗 上路確認：And the plates? Can I drive today?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、ouch、there we go 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這趟櫃台對話走一遍，下次自己面對窗口，話就從嘴邊自然冒出來。

祝你下次辦事一切順利，一趟就完成。
